en: This is a vintage postcard. The front features a black-and-white photograph of a winding river (Indalsälven) flowing through a forested valley with surrounding hills/mountains. There is handwritten text in Swedish around the photograph. At the bottom, printed text reads 'Indalsälfven, Västanå, Liden.' and handwritten text 'Rosenfors den 5/8 1905.' The reverse side includes multiple translations of 'postcard', an address written in Swedish script to 'Fru Sofia Ehedalh, Wisserum', and a Swedish green postage stamp dated 1905.
